facts.fact: Kayla 整周磨人求参加追逐：不让 Aaron 拖她后退
facts.anchor: I won’t allow what Aaron did to me to set me back

facts.fact: Nixie 规则：最后站立者胜，被猎手碰到即出局——她怀疑整场为她设
facts.anchor: the last guest standing will win, but if a hunter touches you, you’re out

facts.fact: Kayla 察觉被驱赶，折返甩开猎人仍撞上 funhouse 前的 Vero
facts.anchor: I am being herded like an animal to where they will be waiting

facts.fact: 逃脱房五问以她的岛史命题，末问直指 Vero
facts.anchor: What did Vero give you that he doesn’t know he gave you?

facts.fact: 她答：Vero 给了她归属，他不知道自己给了什么
facts.anchor: Vero gave me a place to belong. He has no idea what that means to me

facts.fact: Brawley 房间：假面板后纸条「永远相信自己，Double P」
facts.anchor: Stop pushing and find where it wants to move

facts.fact: Clay 房间：feed 七的画外阴影，钥匙与「知道在找什么」的安全论
facts.anchor: The difference between being safe or in danger is knowing what you’re looking for

facts.fact: Ares 房间镜上追问留下的原因，她答厌倦奔跑、被爱真实的版本
facts.anchor: Not what kept you. Not who asked you. Why did you?

facts.fact: 门开四男等候，Kayla 看镜中自己：同一张脸，人已完整
